query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash, script_hash AS h FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash, owner_payment_credential AS h FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01') WHERE h IN ('25da22dfd99bf874e59d74c304a1d28e921310327c3e4d6960123f2e', '4a59ebd93ea53d1bbf7f82232c7b012700a0cf4bb78d879dabb1a20a', '9068a7a3f008803edac87af1619860f2cdcde40c26987325ace138ad', 'a55f409501bf65805bb0dc76f6f9ae90b61e19ed870bc00256813608', 'beb881c47075b2910ae7e13fb268908f70878d06638ff86a5caaa16c', 'c727443d77df6cff95dca383994f4c3024d03ff56b02ecc22b0f3f65')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
